answer: What survives to the cipher is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ocean re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
